title: Roasted Spiced Cauliflower with Tahini
summary: Golden roasted cauliflower tossed with warm Middle Eastern spices and finished with a creamy tahini-lemon sauce. It makes a satisfying vegan dinner, especially with flatbread or grains on the side.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Line a baking tray with baking paper if needed.
Put the cauliflower florets in a large bowl with olive oil, cumin, paprika, ground coriander, garlic powder, salt and black pepper. Toss well so the florets are evenly coated.
Spread the cauliflower out on the tray in a single layer. Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, turning once halfway, until browned at the edges and tender in the centre.
While the cauliflower roasts, mix the tahini, lemon juice, water and grated garlic in a bowl. Stir until smooth and creamy. Add a little more water if needed for a drizzleable consistency.
Transfer the roasted cauliflower to a serving plate. Drizzle over the tahini sauce, then finish with parsley and chilli flakes.
Serve hot as a main dish, with pita, rice or a simple salad if you like.
